newsitem.title: UK: Nat Express details 12.5 mln stg Taybus buy.
newsitem.headline: Nat Express details 12.5 mln stg Taybus buy.

text.p: Passenger transport and airport operator National Express Group Plc said on Friday it had agreed the terms of an agreed formal offer worth up to 12.5 million stg for Scottish bus company Taybus.
The bid has been planned for several months and National Express was selected as preferred bidder last month.

Taybus shareholders will have the option of receiving consideration in cash or loan notes and will be asked to approve the deal at a meeting on February 23, with completion expected the following day, National Express said in a statement.
